block.createpneumatics.roots_blower.tool: Turns rotation into _air pressure_. The front flange pushes, the back one pulls. Run it backwards and they swap.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_tube.to: Carries pressure from a _Roots Blower_. Leave an end open and it blows, or sucks, like a fan.
block.createpneumatics.pressure_gauge.to: Stick it on a tube to read its pressure. Puts out a _comparator_ signal and works with _Display Links_.
block.createpneumatics.relief_valve.tool: Stick it on a tube. Click it or give it _redstone_ to dump the whole network.
createpneumatics.jei.vacuum.chance: %s%% chance, lost if the vacuum breaks
Sits on a _basin_ or _depot_. Hook a tube that pulls _vacuum_ to it and it works what's underneath. Click it to vent and give up a batch.
item.createpneumatics.ration_pack.toolti: Freeze-dried stew. Fills you up and stacks, unlike the bowl it came from.
item.createpneumatics.optical_glass.tool: Glass with every bubble pulled out under vacuum.
block.createpneumatics.glass_pneumatic_t: A _Pneumatic Tube_ you can see into. Does the same job, and you get to watch your items fly past.
block.createpneumatics.vacuum_pad.toolti: Goes on a _contraption_. Lifts the block in front of it, contents and all, and puts it down again when the contraption stops. Works with _Mechanical Arms_ too.
block.createpneumatics.vacuum_tank.toolt: Holds vacuum for _Suction Pads_ and _Bell Jars_ riding the same contraption. Top it up at a _Pneumatic Interface_.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_interfa: Put one on a tube that pulls _vacuum_ and one on a contraption facing it. The contraption waits there until its tanks are full.
block.createpneumatics.pneumatic_termina: Feed it items and it shoots them down the tube. Items riding toward lower pressure drop into the terminal at the end of the line.
block.createpneumatics.air_diverter.tool: Sits in a tube line. Items matching its _filter_ go down its branch, everything else carries on.
createpneumatics.ponder.roots_blower.hea: Moving air with the Roots Blower
createpneumatics.ponder.roots_blower.tex: The Roots Blower takes rotation and moves air through whatever is connected to its two flanges
The front flange pushes air in, so pressure in those tubes goes up
The back flange pulls air out and drops the pressure below zero
Pressure Gauges show the reading of the tube they're stuck to
Reverse the rotation and the two sides swap
Spin it faster for stronger pressure
createpneumatics.ponder.relief_valve.hea: Venting a network with the Relief Valve
createpneumatics.ponder.relief_valve.tex: This network is sealed, so the blower keeps it under pressure
Right-click a Relief Valve to open it. The whole network loses its air while it stays open
A redstone signal holds it open until the signal stops
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.header: Processing under vacuum with the Bell Jar
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.text_1: A Bell Jar sits on a Depot or Basin and works on whatever is inside it
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.text_2: Hook it up to a tube that pulls air out. Nothing happens until the jar is down to a vacuum
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.text_3: Then it pulls the items in and gets to work
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.text_4: Mushroom Stew comes out as a Ration Pack, and you get the bowl back
createpneumatics.ponder.bell_jar.text_5: Some recipes need heat. Put those on a Basin over a Blaze Burner
createpneumatics.ponder.transit.text_1: Pneumatic Terminals load items into tubes and catch them at the other end
createpneumatics.ponder.transit.text_2: Items always ride toward lower pressure, away from a blower that pushes or toward one that pulls
createpneumatics.ponder.transit.text_3: An Air Diverter sends anything matching its filter out of its side
createpneumatics.ponder.transit.text_4: Everything else goes straight through. A redstone signal switches the diverter off
createpneumatics.ponder.vacuum_pad.heade: Picking up blocks with the Vacuum Pad
createpneumatics.ponder.vacuum_pad.text_: Vacuum Pads go on contraptions. When the contraption starts moving, the pad grabs the block it faces
When it stops, the block gets put back down
Every grab uses up vacuum from a Vacuum Tank on the same contraption
Park the contraption with a Pneumatic Interface facing one that a blower pulls on, and the tank fills back up while it waits
